This is best-knowledge originality, not an exhaustive database certification.

value.rationale: This is the complete first four-point extremal profile for both inequivalent nonalternating minimum-length four-run patterns. Length eight is the sharp first divergence of their maximum counts and, for one orbit, the first host length where all optimizers must add runs; it also supplies a precise nonalternating boundary to the three-run log-concavity theorem. Both orbits and all maximizer multiplicities are classified, not an arbitrarily isolated witness.
